key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes, with the RBA urged to pause before raising again (#75)
Aussie banks forecast biggest house price falls on record; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget (#65, #67)
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict (#53); Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle (#70)
Albemarle appoints BHP executive Ragnar Udd as CEO, signalling talent flow from ASX materials majors (#34)
ASIC launches whistleblower review at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns (#55)
China rare earth firms halt select US shipments over geopolitical tensions, supporting rare earth pricing (#26)
Blackstone caps private credit fund withdrawals, a stress signal for global credit markets (#40)
EV sales overtook petrol cars in Australia for first time amid soaring fuel costs (#44)

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical noise; rare earth supply disruptions from China support niche miners; gold projects advancing (Metals One £4m, Aurum West Africa); small-caps Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche leading ASX runners
sectors.implications: BHP.AX and RIO.AX face margin pressure from iron ore consolidation; rare earth and gold names (LRE.AX, GSG.AX) benefit from supply tightness; Macarthur (MCR.AX) milestone supports WA iron ore sentiment

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines; ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four raises governance overhang; CBA/Westpac fee loophole scrutiny
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face credit-cycle headwinds and NIM pressure; rate-hike expectations support short-term margins but elevate NPL risk; governance concerns weigh on sentiment

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel debate intensifies; energy transition costs mounting; Qantas engine incident minor operational risk
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, GWO.AX, ALE.AX benefit from gas price strength; transition-cost narrative pressures renewable names; Beetaloo (BTL.AX) policy risk elevated

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting demand toward tablet GLP-1 alternatives; EV adoption surging in Australia; construction sector under stress (Bathla collapse)
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated; EV supply-chain names gain; construction/REIT exposure (SGH.AX, ICPS.AX) faces demand softening from housing downturn

sectors.trend: Nvidia confirms AI boom persists; OpenAI declares AGI era; skilled-migrant priority for AI workers signals structural demand
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but supportive for CSL.AX (biotech), WES.AX (digital payments); global AI capex cycle benefits Australian data-centre REITs

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to construction-linked REITs (SGH.AX, ICPS.AX); favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify materials exposure toward gold and rare earths; monitor BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX margins

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge long exposure to housing-linked REITs and construction names
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse, record house price fall forecasts, and 15% loan application drop signal structural demand erosion

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore major exposure pending shakeout resolution
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore oversupply masked by geopolitical noise; Macarthur milestone is positive but sector-wide pressure persists

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer and AUD/USD hedge given global credit stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Blackstone withdrawal caps and DXY weakness ahead of NFP create volatility; AUD may weaken on risk-off

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as RBA rate-hike expectations and housing credit contraction dominate. Banks face NIM support but rising NPL risk. Materials mixed: iron ore weak, gold/rare earths firm. Expect 2–4% index volatility into RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Housing correction and construction fragility cap upside for financials and REITs. Materials rotation toward gold and critical minerals offers relative outperformance. AI/tech capex cycle supports select ASX names. 'Bull case returns' narrative (#56) contingent on RBA pausing and credit stabilisation.
